note.zh-TW: 參考值待確認（T24）；流動負債為 0 時的呈現待確認（T28），網站顯示 N/A。
note.en: The reference value (T24) and the presentation when current liabilities are nil (T28) are pending; the site shows N/A.

definition.zh-TW: 扣掉存貨與預付費用後的速動資產，相對於流動負債的倍數，看不靠賣存貨能不能馬上還清短期債務。數值越高，短期償債能力越強。
definition.en: Quick assets (current assets less inventories and prepayments) relative to current liabilities: whether short-term debts could be met without selling stock. Higher means stronger short-term solvency.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
